nome_jp: アクア・ツヴァイソード
testo:
■ For each creature you untapped this turn, this creature costs 2 less to summon. It can't cost 0 or less.
Double Breaker
■ This creature can't be blocked.
■ When you put this creature, choose one of your opponent's creatures. Your opponent puts it on the top or bottom of their deck.
